questions.question: India’s traditional medicine system AYUSH has received formal recognition in bilateral trade agreements with which of the following countries?
questions.questionHtml: India’s traditional medicine system AYUSH has received formal recognition in bilateral trade agreements with which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Oman and New Zealand.

In News

  • India’s traditional medicine system AYUSH has received formal recognition in bilateral trade agreements with Oman and New Zealand.

Key Points

  • India finalised bilateral trade agreements with Oman and New Zealand in December 2025.
  • Both agreements include dedicated annexures on health-related services and traditional medicine, recognising AYUSH.
  • The recognition enhances regulatory clarity and global market access for AYUSH services and products.
  • AYUSH Exports
    • Exports rose by 6.11 per cent in 2024–25
    • Increased from USD 649.2 million to USD 688.89 million
    • Reflects rising global demand for traditional medicine

Additional Information

  • AYUSH
    • Stands for Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
    • Represents India’s traditional medicine systems
    • Promoted globally through trade, health diplomacy and exports
  • Trade Significance
    • Dedicated annexures improve service-sector integration
    • Boosts credibility of Indian traditional medicine abroad
    • Supports India’s health and wellness export strategy

questions.question: The India–France National Centre of Excellence in Aeronautics at Kanpur is being set up under which scheme?
questions.questionHtml: The India–France National Centre of Excellence in Aeronautics at Kanpur is being set up under which scheme?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU)
options.html: Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU).

In News

  • The Prime Minister announced the establishment of the India–France National Centre of Excellence in Aeronautics at Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh under the PM-SETU scheme.

Key Points

  • The Centre will be established at National Skill Training Institute (NSTI), Kanpur in collaboration with the Government of France.
  • It will focus on advanced skill training in aeronautics, MRO, airport operations and defence manufacturing.
  • The initiative builds upon the India–France Strategic Partnership and a 2025 MoU in skill development and vocational training.
  • PM-SETU has an overall outlay of ₹60,000 crore to upgrade 1000 ITIs across India.

Additional Information

  • PM-SETU: A flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship aimed at modernising ITIs and aligning training with industry requirements.
  • National Centre of Excellence (NCoE): A specialised institution designed to deliver high-quality, industry-integrated vocational education and advanced skill training.
  • Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO): Services related to inspection, repair and maintenance of aircraft and aviation equipment.
  • India–France Strategic Partnership: A bilateral framework enhancing cooperation in defence, space, technology, skill development and innovation sectors.

questions.question: India signed its 8th Free Trade Agreement with the European Union at the 16th India–EU Summit in Jan 2026. India has not signed a Free Trade Agreement with which of the following countries?
questions.questionHtml: India signed its 8th Free Trade Agreement with the European Union at the 16th India–EU Summit in Jan 2026. India has not signed a Free Trade Agreement with which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Japan.

In News

  • India and the European Union concluded the India–EU Free Trade Agreement at the 16th India–EU Summit, making the EU India’s 22nd FTA partner.

Key Points

  • India signed its 8th Free Trade Agreement with a European bloc by concluding the India–EU FTA at the 16th India–EU Summit.
  • Since 2014, India has signed trade agreements with Mauritius, UAE, Australia, UK, EFTA, and Oman.
  • In 2025, India signed trade deals with the United Kingdom and Oman and announced the conclusion of a trade deal with New Zealand.
  • India has not signed a Free Trade Agreement with Japan, making it the correct answer.

Additional Information

  • India’s Free Trade Agreements
    • FTAs are aimed at reducing tariffs, improving market access, and strengthening trade relations.
    • India’s recent FTAs focus on trusted partners, services trade, MSMEs, and global value chain integration.
  • India–EU Free Trade Agreement
    • Concluded in January 2026 at the 16th India–EU Summit.
    • Provides preferential market access to over 99 percent of Indian exports to the EU.
  • European Union
    • A 27-member economic bloc.
    • India’s one of the largest trading partners in goods and services.

questions.question: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited-sponsored mountaineer Aritra Roy scaled Mt. Aconcagua, the highest peak outside Asia. In which country is this mountain located?
questions.questionHtml: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited-sponsored mountaineer Aritra Roy scaled Mt. Aconcagua, the highest peak outside Asia. In which country is this mountain located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Argentina.

In News

  • HAL-sponsored Indian mountaineer Aritra Roy successfully summited Mt. Aconcagua in Argentina, the highest mountain outside Asia.

Key Points

  • Mt. Aconcagua is located in Argentina.
  • It is the highest mountain outside Asia, standing at 6,967.15 metres.
  • Aritra Roy reached the summit on January 7, 2026, during a solo expedition.
  • The expedition was fully sponsored by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.

Additional Information

  • Mt. Aconcagua
    • The highest peak in South America and outside Asia
    • Located in the Andes mountain range
  • Aritra Roy
    • An Indian mountaineer pursuing the Seven Summits challenge
    • Previously summited Mount Everest
  • Seven Summits
    • A challenge to climb the highest peak on each of the seven continents
    • Includes Everest, Aconcagua and other continental summits
  • Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
    • An Indian public sector aerospace and defence company
    • Sponsors sporting and national achievement initiatives

questions.question: India pledged a special economic package of __________ to Seychelles to support housing, health, defence, and maritime security.
questions.questionHtml: India pledged a special economic package of __________ to Seychelles to support housing, health, defence, and maritime security.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is $175 million.

In News

  • India announced a special economic package of $175 million for Seychelles to support projects in housing, health, defence, vocational training, e-mobility, and maritime security.

Key Points

  • The package includes a $125 million rupee-denominated line of credit.
  • A $50 million grant has been earmarked for development projects.
  • It also covers training of civilian and defence officials.
  • India will supply 1,000 tonnes of grains and lentils to Seychelles.

Additional Information

  • Seychelles is a key partner in India’s MAHASAGAR vision in the Indian Ocean region.
  • Both countries agreed to deepen cooperation in fintech, digital governance, and maritime security.

questions.question: India and the United Kingdom launched the Offshore Wind Taskforce under which vision framework?
questions.questionHtml: India and the United Kingdom launched the Offshore Wind Taskforce under which vision framework?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Vision 2035.

In News

  • India and the United Kingdom launched the India-UK Offshore Wind Taskforce on February 18, 2026 under Vision 2035.

Key Points

  • The Taskforce was constituted under Vision 2035 and the Fourth India-UK Energy Dialogue.
  • It aims to provide strategic leadership and coordination for India’s nascent offshore wind ecosystem.
  • The initiative focuses on accelerating clean energy cooperation through time-bound and execution-focused collaboration.
  • The framework strengthens India-UK bilateral cooperation in renewable energy, particularly offshore wind development.

Additional Information

  • Vision 2035 is a long-term roadmap guiding strategic cooperation between India and the United Kingdom across sectors such as clean energy, trade, climate action and technology.
  • India-UK Energy Dialogue is a bilateral platform aimed at enhancing collaboration in renewable energy, power sector reforms, grid stability and energy transition initiatives.
  • Offshore Wind Energy refers to wind power projects installed in coastal waters, enabling higher efficiency due to stronger and more consistent wind speeds compared to onshore projects.
  • National Green Hydrogen Mission is India’s flagship initiative to promote production and export of green hydrogen, supporting decarbonisation and energy security goals.

questions.question: The second home for Cheetahs in India (after Kuno) has been identified in which wildlife sanctuary of Madhya Pradesh?
questions.questionHtml: The second home for Cheetahs in India (after Kuno) has been identified in which wildlife sanctuary of Madhya Pradesh?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary.

Key Points

  • The Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary, located in Madhya Pradesh, has been identified as the second site for the reintroduction of cheetahs in India after Kuno National Park.
  • This sanctuary is spread across parts of Mandsaur and Neemuch districts and is known for its diverse flora and fauna, offering a suitable habitat for cheetahs.
  • The decision to identify Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary as a cheetah habitat is part of India’s ambitious Project Cheetah, aimed at reintroducing the species after its extinction in the country.
  • The sanctuary has abundant grasslands and open spaces, which are ideal for cheetahs to thrive and hunt, making it a preferred location for this project.
  • Extensive preparation and habitat assessment have been carried out to ensure the sanctuary can support cheetah populations sustainably, including minimizing human-wildlife conflict.

Additional Information

  • Satpura National Park:
    • Located in the Hoshangabad district of Madhya Pradesh, Satpura National Park is known for its unique terrain, including sandstone peaks, dense forests, and deep ravines.
    • It is part of the Satpura Tiger Reserve and houses a significant population of tigers, leopards, and other wildlife.
    • However, Satpura National Park has not been identified for the cheetah reintroduction project due to its dense forest cover, which is less suitable for cheetahs, who prefer open grasslands for hunting.
  • Panna National Park:
    • Panna National Park is located in the Panna and Chhatarpur districts of Madhya Pradesh and is famous for its tiger conservation efforts under the Project Tiger initiative.
    • The park is known for its riverine forests and diverse wildlife, including tigers, leopards, and gharials.
    • While it is a prominent wildlife sanctuary, it does not meet the specific habitat requirements for cheetahs, such as open grasslands and minimal forest cover.
  • Sanjay-Dubri National Park:
    • Sanjay-Dubri National Park is situated in the Sidhi district of Madhya Pradesh and forms part of the Sanjay Tiger Reserve.
    • It is home to various wildlife species, including tigers, leopards, and chital.
    • The park's dense forests and rugged terrain are not ideal for cheetah reintroduction, which requires large open spaces for their survival and hunting.
  • Project Cheetah:
    • Project Cheetah is an initiative of the Indian government to reintroduce cheetahs, which became extinct in India in 1952, back into the wild.
    • Under this project, eight cheetahs were brought to Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh from Namibia in 2022.
    • The project aims to establish a metapopulation of cheetahs across multiple sites in India to ensure their long-term survival.
    • The identification of Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary as the second site is a significant step in expanding the scope of this initiative.

questions.question: India and Canada signed a joint statement on energy cooperation on the sidelines of which event in January 2026?
questions.questionHtml: India and Canada signed a joint statement on energy cooperation on the sidelines of which event in January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is India Energy Week 2026.

In News

  • India and Canada signed a joint statement on energy cooperation during India Energy Week 2026 held in Goa.

Key Points

  • The joint statement was signed between India’s Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas and Canada’s Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources.
  • The agreement marked the first high-level participation of a Canadian Cabinet Minister at India Energy Week.
  • Both sides launched the renewed India–Canada Ministerial Energy Dialogue.
  • The cooperation focuses on energy security, diversification of supply, and clean energy collaboration.

Additional Information

  • India Energy Week
    • Flagship international energy event organised by the Government of India
    • Provides a platform for global energy dialogue and partnerships
  • Areas of Cooperation
    • Liquefied Natural Gas, Liquefied Petroleum Gas and crude oil trade
    • Renewable energy including hydrogen, biofuels and sustainable aviation fuel
    • Critical minerals, battery storage and clean technologies
  • Strategic Significance
    • Supports India’s growing energy demand and Canada’s export diversification
    • Aligns with global energy transition and climate objectives

questions.question: Which two nations co-chaired the 6th Annual Defence Dialogue in Bengaluru in February 2026?
questions.questionHtml: Which two nations co-chaired the 6th Annual Defence Dialogue in Bengaluru in February 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is India and France.

In News

  • Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh and French Minister Ms. Catherine Vautrin co-chaired the 6th India-France Annual Defence Dialogue in Bengaluru on February 17, 2026.

Key Points

  • Agreement Renewal: The two nations renewed their defence cooperation agreement for another 10 years, reinforcing their long-term strategic partnership.
  • Missile Manufacturing: An MoU was signed between Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and Safran (France) to manufacture Hammer missiles in India.
  • Reciprocal Deployment: For the first time, both countries announced the reciprocal deployment of officers at the Indian Army and French Land Forces establishments.
  • Exercise Shakti: The ministers appreciated the conversion of the bilateral army exercise 'Shakti' from a biennial to an annual event.
  • Strategic Alignment: The dialogue focused on co-development and co-production of equipment, specifically in the field of niche technology and maritime security in the Indian Ocean Region.

About Hammer Missile

  • The Hammer (Highly Agile Modular Munition Extended Range) is a precision-guided stand-off weapon used by the Rafale fighter jets.
  • The indigenous manufacturing of these missiles under the 'Make in India' initiative will significantly boost the Indian Air Force's offensive capabilities.
